title: SCIMATH Integration Wiring â€” Connect Linear Algebra to 25 Downstream Engines
brief: Wire 12 SCIMATH-MS0 engines into ~25 downstream engines across 6 domains that currently roll their own ad-hoc linear algebra. Audit-driven: 10 CRITICAL + 20 HIGH gaps found by 10-agent utilization audit (2026-04-02). Eliminates duplicate code, improves numerical stability, unlocks multivariate analytics.

engines: SVDEngine (390 LOC) â€” decompose, pseudoInverse, leastSquares, conditionNumber
QRDecompositionEngine (420 LOC) â€” decompose, leastSquares, pivotedQR
CholeskyEngine (300 LOC) â€” factorize, ldlt, solve, sampleMultivariateNormal, isPositiveDefinite
EigensolverEngine (760 LOC) â€” symmetricQR, lanczos, generalizedEigen, powerIteration
IterativeSolverEngine (440 LOC) â€” cg, bicgstab, gmres
MatrixFactorizationEngine (450 LOC) â€” toCSR, csrMatVec, lu, solve, nmf
SparseMatrixEngine (400 LOC) â€” rcmOrdering, spMM, bandwidth
MatrixNormEngine (350 LOC) â€” allNorms, conditionNumber, spectralNorm
TensorAlgebraEngine (500 LOC) â€” invariants, principalStresses, rotateTensor
SystemIdentificationEngine (380 LOC) â€” rlsBatch, totalLeastSquares, n4sid
RobustRegressionEngine (450 LOC) â€” ols, ridge, lasso, elasticNet, huber, ransac
PrincipalComponentEngine (550 LOC) â€” calculate, svdPCA, kernelPCA, incrementalPCA, robustPCA
FiniteElementEngine (640 LOC) â€” solveBar, solveTruss, solveQuad4, solveThermal, modalAnalysis

phases.title: Infrastructure â€” Exports, Schemas, Index
phases.intent: Make SCIMATH engines discoverable and type-safe for all downstream consumers

units.title: Export 12 SCIMATH engines from index.ts + update ENGINE_DIGEST
units.description: Add re-exports for all 12 SCIMATH engines to src/engines/index.ts. Update ENGINE_DIGEST.md descriptions from [AUTO-ADDED] stubs to real 1-line descriptions. Update MASTER_INDEX_COMPACT.md.

units.title: Add 12 Zod schemas for SCIMATH calcDispatcher actions
units.description: Add strict Zod schemas to src/schemas/calcActionSchemas.ts for all 12 SCIMATH actions. Currently these pass through .passthrough() without validation. Define input types (matrix, vector, method, options) per action.

phases.title: Quality & SPC â€” Multivariate Analytics (3 CRITICAL)
phases.intent: Shop gets multivariate SPC with real covariance analysis instead of diagonal approximations. Cpk includes measurement uncertainty per ISO 22514-1.

units.title: Wire PCA/SVD â†’ StatisticalProcessMonitoringEngine
units.description: Replace inline _eigenDecomp() with PrincipalComponentEngine.svdPCA() or SVDEngine.decompose(). pcaProcessMonitoring() currently computes Hotelling TÂ² and SPE with ad-hoc eigendecomposition. Switch to SVD for numerical stability in 30+ dimensional measurement spaces. Cache decomposition for repeated queries.

units.title: Wire Cholesky â†’ ProcessFingerprintEngine (full Hotelling TÂ²)
units.description: Replace diagonal covariance approximation (line 462 comment: 'diagonal covariance approximation') with full covariance matrix via CholeskyEngine.factorize() + solve(). Compute true Mahalanobis distance: TÂ² = (x-mu)^T * Sigma^{-1} * (x-mu). Cache Cholesky factor for baseline fingerprints.

units.title: Wire Cholesky â†’ SPCProcessCapabilityEngine (uncertainty propagation)
units.description: Extend compute() to accept expanded measurement uncertainty U and propagate via Cholesky-backed Monte Carlo. Current Cpk confidence intervals ignore measurement uncertainty. ISO 22514-1 compliance requires GUM analysis. Use CholeskyEngine.sampleMultivariateNormal() for correlated uncertainty sources.

phases.title: ML & Optimization â€” Stable Matrix Operations (3 CRITICAL)
phases.smart_config: ROLE=Numerical Methods + ML Engineer | OPUS | MAXIMUM
phases.intent: Optimization engines stop crashing on ill-conditioned problems. Bayesian optimization handles noisy sensor data. All regression uses numerically stable SVD/QR backend.

units.title: Wire Cholesky â†’ BayesianOptimizationEngine (GP kernel solve)
units.description: Replace _invertMatrix() (Gauss-Jordan, lines 163-325) with CholeskyEngine.factorize() + solve() for GP kernel matrix. SPD kernels are 2x faster with Cholesky. Add conditionNumber check before inversion (warn at kappa > 1e12).

units.title: Wire Cholesky/SVD â†’ ConvexOptimizationEngine (QP Hessian)
units.description: Replace manual Gaussian elimination (lines 385-421) with CholeskyEngine for SPD Hessians, SVD fallback for indefinite. Add condition monitoring to detect ill-conditioned optimization landscapes.

units.title: Wire SVD â†’ AdvancedRegressionEngine + AIMLFormulasEngine + GradientOpt
units.description: AdvancedRegressionEngine: replace module-level solveLinearSystem() (used by OLS, SVR, kernel ridge, logistic) with SVDEngine.leastSquares(). AIMLFormulasEngine: replace _solveLinearSystem() and power iteration PCA. GradientOptimizationEngine: add condition number check before BFGS Hessian inversion.

phases.title: Physics Pipeline â€” Core Manufacturing (1 CRITICAL + 2 HIGH)
phases.smart_config: ROLE=Manufacturing Physicist + Controls Engineer | OPUS | MAXIMUM
phases.intent: Online tool-life calibration converges properly. Speed-feed UQ catches ill-conditioned covariance. Kienzle coefficients fit from real data instead of hardcoded empirical formulas.

units.title: Wire SystemID.rls â†’ AdaptiveCalibrationEngine (replace hand-rolled Kalman)
units.description: Replace 2x2 hand-coded Kalman filter for Taylor [ln(C), n] with SystemIdentificationEngine.rlsBatch(). Add forgetting factor for tool batch changes. Use TLS for errors-in-variables (both speed and life have noise).

units.title: Wire SVD conditionNumber â†’ SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine UQ
units.description: Add SVDEngine.conditionNumber() check on resolver covariance matrices before Monte Carlo sampling. Warn when condition number exceeds threshold (ill-conditioned physics model).

units.title: Wire RobustRegression â†’ KienzleForceModelEngine (coefficient fitting)
units.description: Add fitCoefficients() using Ridge regression to fit hardness-to-kc1.1 from MaterialRegistry data. Replace hardcoded empirical formulas (e.g., 3.5*HB for steel, R2~0.90) with data-driven fits. Keep hardcoded as fallback.

phases.title: Chatter & Vibration â€” Multi-Mode Physics (3 HIGH)
phases.smart_config: ROLE=Vibration Physicist + Controls Engineer | OPUS | MAXIMUM
phases.intent: Chatter stability lobe diagrams use multi-mode FRF synthesis instead of SDOF approximation. Tap-test data actually updates the model. Stiffness comes from geometry, not defaults.

units.title: Wire EigensolverEngine â†’ ChatterStabilityLobeEngine (multi-mode SLD)
units.description: Upgrade from single-DOF FRF to multi-mode synthesis. Use EigensolverEngine.generalizedEigen(K, M) to extract tool-workpiece modal basis (2-5 modes), then synthesize oriented FRF as superposition. Currently hardcodes SDOF impedance formula (lines 124-127).

units.title: Wire SystemID.n4sid â†’ StochasticChatterEngine (Bayesian tap-test)
units.description: Implement stub Bayesian tap-test updating using SystemIdentificationEngine.n4sid() to estimate (fn, zeta) from measured FRF data. Currently accepts tap-test data but never processes it (null everywhere).
exit_conditions: Bayesian prior update from measured FRF

units.title: Wire FEM.modalAnalysis â†’ MachineVibrationEngine (geometry-based stiffness)
units.description: Replace default 20 N/um stiffness (line 76) with FEM-computed tool-holder stiffness. Use FiniteElementEngine.modalAnalysis() for natural frequency computation from tool geometry (E, rho, A, L). Add directional compliance.
exit_conditions: Tests against published tool holder data

phases.title: Deflection & Structural â€” FEM Upgrade Path (3 HIGH)
phases.smart_config: ROLE=Structural Engineer + CNC Tooling Specialist | OPUS | MAXIMUM
phases.intent: Complex tool assemblies (HSK tapers, stepped boring bars) get FEM-backed deflection instead of oversimplified cantilever beam. Fixture clamps get contact stress analysis. Resonance cross-check prevents cutting at natural frequency.

units.title: Wire FEM â†’ ToolAssemblyDeflectionEngine (complex taper geometry)
units.description: Add FEM option alongside existing cascaded cantilever for tool assemblies with abrupt diameter changes. Use solveBar() for axial + optional solveQuad4() for radial compliance at taper interfaces. 15-30% accuracy gain for HSK/BT tapers.

units.title: Wire FEM â†’ FixtureDynamicsEngine (clamp jaw contact stress)
units.description: Use solveQuad4() for clamp jaw contact stress analysis. Current single-beam cantilever misses localized yielding near corners. Add von Mises stress check at contact patches.
exit_conditions: Quad4 plane stress for clamp faces

units.title: Wire FEM modal â†’ deflection engines (resonance cross-check)
units.description: Add FEM natural frequency check to ToolAssemblyDeflectionEngine and BoringBarDeflectionEngine. Flag resonance risk if tool natural frequency is within +/-10% of spindle speed or tooth-passing frequency.

phases.title: Downstream Math Cleanup + Monte Carlo + Integration Tests
phases.smart_config: ROLE=Numerical Methods + Test Engineer | OPUS | HIGH
phases.intent: All remaining ad-hoc linear algebra is replaced. Comprehensive integration tests verify no regression. MonteCarloEngine samples correlated parameters properly.

units.title: Wire SVD â†’ StochasticWrapperEngine (PCE coefficient fitting)
units.description: Replace _leastSquares() + _solveLinear() with SVDEngine.leastSquares() for Polynomial Chaos Expansion coefficient fitting. Improves numerical stability for high-order PCE.

units.title: Wire Eigensolver â†’ CMMPathPlanningEngine + DifferentialEquationEngine
units.description: CMMPathPlanningEngine: replace _smallestEigenvector3x3() (cubic characteristic polynomial) with EigensolverEngine. DifferentialEquationEngine: replace Gershgorin bounds with proper eigenvalue stability analysis.

units.title: Wire Cholesky â†’ MonteCarloEngine + SystemID â†’ AdaptiveControlEngine
units.description: MonteCarloEngine: replace scalar Box-Muller with CholeskyEngine.sampleMultivariateNormal(). AdaptiveControlEngine: replace ad-hoc gain computation with SystemIdentificationEngine.rlsBatch().

units.title: Integration test suite â€” 30+ cross-domain SCIMATH consumer tests
units.description: Write comprehensive integration tests verifying all wired engines produce equivalent or better results. Compare old (ad-hoc) vs new (SCIMATH) paths. Performance benchmark: SCIMATH path must be within 2x latency of original.
exit_conditions: No regression in existing test suites
